# Simulation to compare far() and plug-in forecasting

```{r}
grid_forecast <- data.frame(
  T = 500,
  d = 1,
  p = 1L,
  q = 0L,
  ar_strength = 0.8,
  ma_strength = 0.8
)

plan(multisession, workers = 10)
handlers("progress")

forecast_sim <- parallel_sim_forecasting_FARMA_compare_compact(
  n_rep = 100,
  grid = grid_forecast,
  h_max = 10,
  train_ratio = 0.6,
  valid_ratio = 0.2,
  alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
  window_types = c("expanding", "fixed"),
  Npc = 1,
  no_grid = 101,
  far_pve = 0.95,
  fracdiff_trim = 150
)
```

### Plots of RMSE ratio
```{r}
make_forecast_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                        metric_col = "RMSE",
                                        method_col = "method",
                                        farma_label = "FARMA",
                                        far_label = "FAR(1)") {
  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need `T` or `n` column.")
  }
  
  wide_farma <- intersect(c("RMSE_farma", "rmse_farma", "RMSE_FARMA"), names(df))
  
  wide_far <- intersect(c("RMSE_far", "rmse_far", "RMSE_FAR"), names(df))
  
  if (length(wide_farma) > 0 &&
      length(wide_far) > 0) {
    out <- df %>%
      mutate(rmse_ratio =
               .data[[wide_farma[1]]] /
               .data[[wide_far[1]]])
    
  } else {
    if (!metric_col %in% names(df)) {
      stop("Cannot find metric column. Change `metric_col`.")
    }
    
    if (!method_col %in% names(df)) {
      stop("Cannot find method column. Change `method_col`.")
    }
    
    group_vars <- intersect(
      c(
        T_name,
        "h",
        "window_type",
        "ar_strength",
        "ma_strength",
        "p_true",
        "q_true",
        "d",
        "d_true"
      ),
      names(df)
    )
    
    out <- df %>%
      mutate(
        method_use = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[method_col]])), "farma") ~ farma_label,
          
          str_detect(
            tolower(as.character(.data[[method_col]])),
            "far\\(1\\)|far1|far_1|plugin|far$"
          ) ~ far_label,
          
          TRUE ~ as.character(.data[[method_col]])
        )
      ) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars)), method_use) %>%
      summarise(metric_value = mean(.data[[metric_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = method_use, values_from = metric_value)
    
    if (!farma_label %in% names(out)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Cannot find FARMA method after reshaping. ",
          "Check `method_col` and method labels."
        )
      )
    }
    
    if (!far_label %in% names(out)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Cannot find FAR(1) method after reshaping. ",
          "Check `method_col` and method labels."
        )
      )
    }
    
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(rmse_ratio =
               .data[[farma_label]] /
               .data[[far_label]])
  }
  
  if (!"ar_strength" %in% names(out)) {
    out$ar_strength <- NA_real_
  }
  
  if (!"ma_strength" %in% names(out)) {
    out$ma_strength <- NA_real_
  }
  
  if (!"window_type" %in% names(out)) {
    out$window_type <- "Window"
  }
  
  psi_vals <- sort(unique(out$ar_strength[is.finite(out$ar_strength)]))
  
  nu_vals <- sort(unique(out$ma_strength[is.finite(out$ma_strength)]))
  
  out %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model_label = paste0("FARFIMA(", p_true, ",1,", q_true, ")"),
      
      T_factor = factor(T_value, levels = sort(unique(T_value))),
      
      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
        
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
        
        TRUE ~ as.character(window_type)
      ),
      
      window_type = factor(window_type, levels = c("Expanding", "Fixed")),
      
      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)",
          "(2,0)",
          "(0,1)",
          "(0,2)",
          "(1,1)",
          "(2,1)",
          "(1,2)",
          "(2,2)"
        )
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", psi_vals)),
      
      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", nu_vals))
    )
}

get_T_cols <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))
  
  cols <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "#66A61E")
  
  if (length(T_levels) > length(cols)) {
    stop("Not enough colours for the number of sample sizes.")
  }
  
  setNames(cols[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

get_window_ltys <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))
  
  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")
  
  if (length(window_levels) > length(ltys)) {
    stop("Not enough line types for the number of windows.")
  }
  
  setNames(ltys[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

get_window_shapes <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))
  
  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)
  
  if (length(window_levels) > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Not enough shapes for the number of windows.")
  }
  
  setNames(shapes[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

plot_forecast_ratio_one_model <- function(df,
                                          model_show,
                                          title = NULL,
                                          show_legend = FALSE,
                                          y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }
  
  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)
  
  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]
  
  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])
  
  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = rmse_ratio,
      group = interaction(T_factor, window_type),
      colour = T_factor,
      linetype = window_type,
      shape = window_type
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = get_T_cols(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_window_ltys(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_window_shapes(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      colour = "Sample size T",
      linetype = "Window",
      shape = "Window"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) {
        "top"
      } else {
        "none"
      },
      
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold"),
      
      legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }
  
  g
}

make_forecast_legend_manual <- function(df) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
           window_type = droplevels(window_type))
  
  T_levels <- levels(df_use$T_factor)
  W_levels <- levels(df_use$window_type)
  
  x_title <- 0
  x_item_start <- 3.0
  item_gap <- 3.7
  
  line_length <- 0.75
  text_gap <- 0.45
  
  T_df <- tibble(
    T_factor = factor(T_levels, levels = T_levels),
    
    x_symbol = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,
    
    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,
    
    y = 1.00,
    
    label = paste0("T = ", T_levels)
  )
  
  W_df <- tibble(
    window_type = factor(W_levels, levels = W_levels),
    
    x_start = x_item_start +
      (seq_along(W_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,
    
    x_end = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(W_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,
    
    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(W_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,
    
    y = 0.55,
    label = W_levels
  )
  
  xmax <- max(c(T_df$x_text + 1.8, W_df$x_text + 2.2), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 1.00,
      label = "Sample size T",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_symbol, y = y, colour = T_factor),
      size = legend_point_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 0.55,
      label = "Window",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = W_df,
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        linetype = window_type
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = W_df,
      aes(x = x_end, y = y, shape = window_type),
      size = legend_point_size,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = W_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = get_T_cols(df_use)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_window_ltys(df_use)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_window_shapes(df_use)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax),
                    ylim = c(0.35, 1.15),
                    clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

combine_four_forecast_models_shared_axes <- function(df,
                                                     models,
                                                     titles,
                                                     file_name = NULL,
                                                     width = 16,
                                                     height = 12,
                                                     y_limits = NULL) {
  if (length(models) != 4) {
    stop("`models` must contain exactly four model labels.")
  }
  
  if (length(titles) != 4) {
    stop("`titles` must contain exactly four plot titles.")
  }
  
  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) %in% models)
  
  if (nrow(df_use) == 0) {
    stop("No observations remain for the requested models.")
  }
  
  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_range <- range(c(df_use$rmse_ratio, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    pad <- 0.06 * diff(y_range)
    
    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) {
      pad <- 0.05
    }
    
    y_limits <- c(y_range[1] - pad, y_range[2] + pad)
  }
  
  legend <- make_forecast_legend_manual(df_use)
  
  p1 <- plot_forecast_ratio_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[1],
    title = titles[1],
    show_legend = FALSE,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p2 <- plot_forecast_ratio_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[2],
    title = titles[2],
    show_legend = FALSE,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p3 <- plot_forecast_ratio_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[3],
    title = titles[3],
    show_legend = FALSE,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p4 <- plot_forecast_ratio_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[4],
    title = titles[4],
    show_legend = FALSE,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,
                                  p2,
                                  p3,
                                  p4,
                                  ncol = 2,
                                  align = "hv",
                                  axis = "tblr")
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "RMSE ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)",
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("Forecast horizon h",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.022,
                        size = shared_label_size)
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

### Plots for ECP
```{r}
make_interval_plot_summary <- function(df, alpha_show = 0.05) {
  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need a `T` or `n` column.")
  }
  
  if (!"alpha" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Cannot find the `alpha` column.")
  }
  
  if (!"method" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Cannot find the `method` column.")
  }
  
  df %>%
    filter(abs(as.numeric(alpha) - alpha_show) < 1e-10) %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      T_factor = factor(T_value, levels = sort(unique(T_value))),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      
      method = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(method)), "farma") ~ "farma",
        
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(method)), "far\\(1\\)|far1|far_1|far$") ~ "far",
        
        TRUE ~ tolower(as.character(method))
      ),
      
      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
        
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
        
        TRUE ~ as.character(window_type)
      ),
      
      window_type = factor(window_type, levels = c("Expanding", "Fixed")),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model = factor(model, levels = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")),
      
      model_label = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ as.character(model)
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", sort(
        unique(ar_strength)
      ))),
      
      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", sort(
        unique(ma_strength)
      )))
    )
}

make_ecp_summary <- function(df,
                             alpha_show = 0.05,
                             window_show = "Expanding") {
  make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show) %>%
    filter(method %in% c("far", "farma"), window_type == window_show) %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(
        method,
        levels = c("far", "farma"),
        labels = c("FAR(1)", "FARFIMA")
      ),
      
      T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
      window_type = droplevels(window_type)
    )
}

make_ecp_legend_no_window <- function(df) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(method = droplevels(method), T_factor = droplevels(T_factor))
  
  method_levels <- levels(df_use$method)
  T_levels <- levels(df_use$T_factor)
  
  x_title <- 0
  x_item_start <- 3.0
  item_gap <- 3.9
  line_length <- 0.75
  text_gap <- 0.45
  
  method_df <- tibble(
    method = factor(method_levels, levels = method_levels),
    
    x_start = x_item_start +
      (seq_along(method_levels) - 1) * item_gap,
    
    x_end = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(method_levels) - 1) * item_gap,
    
    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(method_levels) - 1) * item_gap,
    
    y = 1.00,
    label = method_levels
  )
  
  T_df <- tibble(
    T_factor = factor(T_levels, levels = T_levels),
    
    x_start = x_item_start +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * item_gap,
    
    x_end = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * item_gap,
    
    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * item_gap,
    
    y = 0.55,
    label = paste0("T = ", T_levels)
  )
  
  xmax <- max(c(method_df$x_text + 2.2, T_df$x_text + 1.8), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 1.00,
      label = "Method",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = method_df,
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        colour = method
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = method_df,
      aes(x = x_end, y = y, colour = method),
      size = legend_point_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = method_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 0.55,
      label = "Sample size T",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = T_df,
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        linetype = T_factor
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_end, y = y, shape = T_factor),
      size = legend_point_size,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_ecp) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes_ecp(df_use)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_T_ltys_ecp(df_use)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax),
                    ylim = c(0.35, 1.15),
                    clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

plot_ecp_one_model <- function(df,
                               model_show,
                               title = NULL,
                               alpha_show = 0.05,
                               y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }
  
  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)
  
  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]
  
  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])
  
  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = ECP,
      group = interaction(method, T_factor),
      colour = method,
      linetype = T_factor,
      shape = T_factor
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1 - alpha_show,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_ecp, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_T_ltys_ecp(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes_ecp(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
      labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }
  
  g
}

combine_four_ecp_models_shared_axes <- function(df,
                                                models,
                                                titles,
                                                alpha_show = 0.05,
                                                file_name = NULL,
                                                width = 16,
                                                height = 12,
                                                y_limits = NULL,
                                                y_axis_label = "Empirical coverage probability") {
  if (length(models) != 4) {
    stop("`models` must contain exactly four model labels.")
  }
  
  if (length(titles) != 4) {
    stop("`titles` must contain exactly four plot titles.")
  }
  
  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) %in% models)
  
  if (nrow(df_use) == 0) {
    stop("No observations remain for the requested models.")
  }
  
  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_range <- range(c(df_use$ECP, 1 - alpha_show), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    pad <- 0.04 * diff(y_range)
    
    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) {
      pad <- 0.03
    }
    
    y_limits <- range(c(y_range[1] - pad, y_range[2] + pad), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    y_limits[1] <- max(0, y_limits[1])
    
    y_limits[2] <- min(1, y_limits[2])
  }
  
  legend <- make_ecp_legend_no_window(df_use)
  
  p1 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[1],
    title = titles[1],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p2 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[2],
    title = titles[2],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p3 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[3],
    title = titles[3],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p4 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[4],
    title = titles[4],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,
                                  p2,
                                  p3,
                                  p4,
                                  ncol = 2,
                                  align = "hv",
                                  axis = "tblr")
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      y_axis_label,
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("Forecast horizon h",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.022,
                        size = shared_label_size)
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

```{r}
get_score_window_ltys <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))
  
  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")
  
  setNames(ltys[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

get_score_window_shapes <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))
  
  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)
  
  setNames(shapes[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

make_score_legend_manual <- function(df) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
           window_type = droplevels(window_type))
  
  T_levels <- levels(df_use$T_factor)
  window_levels <- levels(df_use$window_type)
  
  T_df <- tibble(
    T_factor = factor(T_levels, levels = T_levels),
    x_symbol = 3.8 +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * 3.6,
    x_text = 4.5 +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * 3.6,
    y = 1,
    label = paste0("T = ", T_levels)
  )
  
  window_df <- tibble(
    window_type = factor(window_levels, levels = window_levels),
    x_start = 3.3 +
      (seq_along(window_levels) - 1) * 3.6,
    x_end = 3.8 +
      (seq_along(window_levels) - 1) * 3.6,
    x_text = 4.5 +
      (seq_along(window_levels) - 1) * 3.6,
    y = 0.55,
    label = window_levels
  )
  
  xmax <- max(c(T_df$x_text + 2, window_df$x_text + 2), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      label = "Sample size T",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(data = T_df,
               aes(x = x_symbol, y = y, colour = T_factor),
               size = legend_point_size) +
    geom_text(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.55,
      label = "Window",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = window_df,
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        linetype = window_type
      ),
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = legend_line_width
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = window_df,
      aes(x = x_end, y = y, shape = window_type),
      colour = "black",
      size = legend_point_size
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = window_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = get_T_cols(df_use)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_score_window_ltys(df_use)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_score_window_shapes(df_use)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax),
                    ylim = c(0.35, 1.15),
                    clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

make_score_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                     alpha_show = 0.05,
                                     score_col = "Score") {
  df_use <- make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show)
  
  if (!score_col %in% names(df_use)) {
    stop(paste("Cannot find score column:", score_col))
  }
  
  score_summary <- df_use %>%
    group_by(
      T_value,
      T_factor,
      h,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      psi_label,
      nu_label,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_label,
      window_type,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(score_value = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = score_value)
  
  if (!"farma" %in% names(score_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find the FARMA score after reshaping. Check the `method` labels.")
  }
  
  if (!"far" %in% names(score_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find the FAR(1) score after reshaping. Check the `method` labels.")
  }
  
  score_summary %>%
    mutate(score_ratio = farma / far)
}
```

```{r}
grid_pipeline <- expand.grid(
  T = c(500, 1000),
  d = c(0.4, 0.8, 1.2),
  ar_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  ma_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  model = c("1_0", "0_1", "1_1", "2_0")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 1L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 0L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 2L
    ),
    q = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 0L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 0L
    ),
    ar_strength = dplyr::if_else(p == 0, 0, ar_strength),
    ma_strength = dplyr::if_else(q == 0, 0, ma_strength)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength)


future::plan(
  future::multisession,
  workers = 10
)

progressr::handlers("progress")

out_ic <- parallel_repeat_full_forecasting_pipeline_compact_order_method(
  n_rep = 10,
  grid = grid_pipeline,
  order_selection_method = "both",
  fracdiff_trim = 200,
  far_benchmark_d = 1,
  window_types = c("expanding", "fixed"),
  cv_order_window_type = "expanding"
)
```

## Analysis 

```{r}
unified_forecast_res_main <- readRDS("pipeline_forecast_summary.rds")
unified_forecast_res_add <- readRDS("pipeline_forecast_summary_additional.rds")

append_one_component <- function(df_main, df_add) {
  if (is.null(df_main))
    return(df_add)
  if (is.null(df_add))
    return(df_main)
  
  if (!is.data.frame(df_main) || !is.data.frame(df_add)) {
    stop("Both objects must be data frames / tibbles.")
  }
  
  df_add_new <- df_add
  
  if ("scenario_id" %in% names(df_main) &&
      "scenario_id" %in% names(df_add)) {
    max_id <- max(df_main$scenario_id, na.rm = TRUE)
    df_add_new <- df_add_new %>%
      mutate(scenario_id = scenario_id + max_id)
  }
  
  bind_rows(df_main, df_add_new)
}

combine_forecast_results <- function(res_main, res_add) {
  all_names <- union(names(res_main), names(res_add))
  
  out <- vector("list", length(all_names))
  names(out) <- all_names
  
  for (nm in all_names) {
    out[[nm]] <- append_one_component(df_main = res_main[[nm]], df_add  = res_add[[nm]])
  }
  
  out
}

unified_forecast_res <- combine_forecast_results(
  unified_forecast_res_main,
  unified_forecast_res_add
)
```

### Estimation of d

```{r}
legend_title_size <- 18
legend_text_size <- 16

clean_d_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("order_selection_method")) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(n),
      d_true = as.numeric(d_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model_label = dplyr::case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ model
      ),
      
      MSE_d = RMSE_d^2
    )
}

make_d_est_plot_data_singleT <- function(df, T_show, balanced_farma = TRUE) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(T_value == T_show,
                  model %in% c("(1,0)", "(2,0)", "(0,1)", "(1,1)"))
  
  if (balanced_farma) {
    df_use <- df_use %>%
      dplyr::filter(model != "(1,1)" |
                      abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10)
  }
  
  df_use %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      strength_value = dplyr::case_when(
        model %in% c("(1,0)", "(2,0)") ~ ar_strength,
        model == "(0,1)" ~ ma_strength,
        model == "(1,1)" ~ ar_strength
      ),
      
      strength_factor = factor(
        strength_value,
        levels = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
        labels = c("0.2", "0.5", "0.8")
      ),
      
      model_label = factor(
        model_label,
        levels = c(
          "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
          "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
          "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
          "FARFIMA(1,d,1)"
        )
      )
    )
}

plot_d_est_metric_singleT <- function(df,
                                      metric_col,
                                      y_lab,
                                      add_zero_line = FALSE,
                                      show_x_lab = TRUE,
                                      show_legend = TRUE,
                                      show_strips = TRUE,
                                      plot_title = NULL) {
  strength_cols <- c(
    "0.2" = "#1B9E77",
    "0.5" = "#D95F02",
    "0.8" = "#7570B3"
  )
  
  g <- ggplot(df,
              aes(
                x = d_true,
                y = .data[[metric_col]],
                colour = strength_factor,
                group = strength_factor
              )) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    facet_wrap(~ model_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df$d_true)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = strength_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = if (show_x_lab) {
        "True memory parameter d"
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      y = y_lab,
      colour = "Dependence strength"
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = legend_line_width, size = legend_point_size)
    )) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) {
        "top"
      } else {
        "none"
      },
      
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.justification = "center",
      
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold"),
      
      legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      
      legend.key.width = unit(1.8, "lines"),
      
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      
      strip.background = if (show_strips) {
        element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black")
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      
      strip.text = if (show_strips) {
        element_text(size = strip_text_size)
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size,
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = shared_label_size),
      
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = shared_label_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (add_zero_line) {
    g <- g +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        colour = "black",
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = reference_line_width
      )
  }
  
  g
}

plot_d_estimation_two_panel_singleT <- function(df,
                                                T_show,
                                                file_name = NULL,
                                                width = 16,
                                                height = 10) {
  df_plot <- make_d_est_plot_data_singleT(df = df,
                                          T_show = T_show,
                                          balanced_farma = TRUE)
  
  p_bias <- plot_d_est_metric_singleT(
    df = df_plot,
    metric_col = "mean_d_bias",
    y_lab = "Mean bias",
    add_zero_line = TRUE,
    show_x_lab = FALSE,
    show_legend = TRUE,
    show_strips = TRUE,
    plot_title = NULL
  )
  
  p_mse <- plot_d_est_metric_singleT(
    df = df_plot,
    metric_col = "MSE_d",
    y_lab = "MSE",
    add_zero_line = FALSE,
    show_x_lab = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    show_strips = FALSE,
    plot_title = NULL
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_bias,
    p_mse,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "v",
    axis = "lr",
    rel_heights = c(1, 1)
  )
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0,
      y = 0.075,
      width = 1,
      height = 0.925
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("True memory parameter d",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.018,
                        size = shared_label_size)
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

### Order selection accuracy

```{r}
# Restore the compact legend used by the remaining figures.
legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7

method_cols_order <- c("Functional IC" = "#D95F02", "CV" = "#7570B3")

method_ltys_order <- c("Functional IC" = "solid", "CV" = "dashed")

method_shapes_order <- c("Functional IC" = 16, "CV" = 17)

make_order_accuracy_plot_data <- function(df, metric_col = "order_accuracy") {
  if (!metric_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste("Cannot find metric column:", metric_col))
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(n),
      d_true = as.numeric(d_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model = factor(model, levels = c("(1,0)", "(2,0)", "(0,1)", "(1,1)")),
      
      model_title = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ as.character(model)
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", sort(
        unique(ar_strength)
      ))),
      
      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", sort(
        unique(ma_strength)
      ))),
      
      method = case_when(
        order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ order_selection_method
      ),
      
      method = factor(method, levels = c("Functional IC", "CV")),
      
      accuracy_value = .data[[metric_col]]
    )
}

make_order_method_legend <- function() {
  legend_df <- tibble(
    method = factor(c("Functional IC", "CV"), levels = c("Functional IC", "CV")),
    x_start = c(3.2, 7.0),
    x_end = c(3.95, 7.75),
    x_text = c(4.25, 8.05),
    y = 1
  )
  
  ggplot(legend_df) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      label = "Order selection",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        colour = method,
        linetype = method
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = x_end,
        y = y,
        colour = method,
        shape = method
      ),
      size = legend_point_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = method),
              hjust = 0,
              size = legend_text_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_order) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_order) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes_order) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 11),
                    ylim = c(0.85, 1.15),
                    clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d <- function(df,
                                               model_show,
                                               T_show,
                                               title = NULL,
                                               y_limits = c(0, 1.02)) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show, T_value == T_show)
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show, "and T =", T_show))
  }
  
  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)
  
  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]
  
  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])
  
  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = d_true,
      y = accuracy_value,
      group = method,
      colour = method,
      linetype = method,
      shape = method
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_order, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_order, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes_order, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$d_true)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }
  
  g
}

combine_four_order_accuracy_fixedT <- function(df,
                                               T_show,
                                               file_name = NULL,
                                               width = 16,
                                               height = 12,
                                               y_limits = c(0, 1.02)) {
  legend <- make_order_method_legend()
  
  p1 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,0)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p2 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(2,0)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p3 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(0,1)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p4 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,1)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,
                                  p2,
                                  p3,
                                  p4,
                                  ncol = 2,
                                  align = "hv",
                                  axis = "tblr")
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Selection accuracy",
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("True memory parameter d",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.022,
                        size = shared_label_size)
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

### Plots of RMSE ratio


```{r}
method_cols_unified <- c("Functional IC" = "#D95F02", "CV" = "#7570B3")

method_ltys_unified <- c("Functional IC" = "solid", "CV" = "dashed")

method_shapes_unified <- c("Functional IC" = 16, "CV" = 17)

make_unified_balanced_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                                window_show = "expanding",
                                                T_show = 1000) {
  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need `T` or `n` column.")
  }
  
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      d_true = as.numeric(d_true),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      
      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
        
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
        
        TRUE ~ as.character(window_type)
      ),
      
      order_selection_method = case_when(
        order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ as.character(order_selection_method)
      ),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")")
    )
  
  if (!"RMSE_ratio" %in% names(df_use)) {
    df_use <- df_use %>%
      mutate(RMSE_ratio = RMSE_farma / RMSE_far)
  }
  
  window_show_clean <- case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(window_show), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
    
    str_detect(tolower(window_show), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
    
    TRUE ~ window_show
  )
  
  df_use <- df_use %>%
    filter(
      window_type == window_show_clean,
      T_value == T_show,
      model %in% c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
    ) %>%
    filter((p_true > 0 & q_true == 0) |
             (p_true == 0 & q_true > 0) |
             (p_true > 0 &
                q_true > 0 &
                abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10)) %>%
    mutate(
      model_title = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ model
      ),
      
      d_label = paste0("d==", d_true),
      
      strength_value = case_when(
        p_true > 0 & q_true == 0 ~ ar_strength,
        p_true == 0 & q_true > 0 ~ ma_strength,
        p_true > 0 & q_true > 0 ~ ar_strength,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      
      strength_label = case_when(
        p_true > 0 & q_true == 0 ~ paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        
        p_true == 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        
        p_true > 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("psi~'='~nu~'='~", ar_strength),
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      order_selection_method = factor(order_selection_method, levels = c("Functional IC", "CV")),
      
      model = factor(model, levels = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)"))
    )
  
  d_levels <- df_use %>%
    distinct(d_true, d_label) %>%
    arrange(d_true) %>%
    pull(d_label)
  
  strength_levels <- df_use %>%
    distinct(strength_value, strength_label) %>%
    arrange(strength_value) %>%
    pull(strength_label)
  
  df_use %>%
    mutate(
      d_label = factor(d_label, levels = d_levels),
      
      strength_label = factor(strength_label, levels = strength_levels)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      T_value,
      d_true,
      d_label,
      strength_value,
      strength_label,
      h,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_title,
      order_selection_method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE_ratio = mean(RMSE_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      RMSE_far = mean(RMSE_far, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      RMSE_farma = mean(RMSE_farma, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      n_rep_used = mean(n_rep_used, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

make_unified_method_legend <- function() {
  legend_df <- tibble(
    order_selection_method = factor(c("Functional IC", "CV"), levels = c("Functional IC", "CV")),
    x_start = c(3.0, 7.0),
    x_end = c(3.75, 7.75),
    x_text = c(4.08, 8.08),
    y = 1
  )
  
  ggplot(legend_df) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      label = "Order selection",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        colour = order_selection_method,
        linetype = order_selection_method
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = x_end,
        y = y,
        colour = order_selection_method,
        shape = order_selection_method
      ),
      size = legend_point_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = order_selection_method),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_unified) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_unified) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes_unified) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 12),
                    ylim = c(0.85, 1.15),
                    clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

plot_unified_balanced_one_model <- function(df, model_show, y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }
  
  title_use <- unique(df_sub$model_title)[1]
  
  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_range <- range(c(df_sub$RMSE_ratio, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    pad <- 0.06 * diff(y_range)
    
    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) {
      pad <- 0.05
    }
    
    y_limits <- range(c(y_range[1] - pad, y_range[2] + pad), na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = RMSE_ratio,
      group = order_selection_method,
      colour = order_selection_method,
      linetype = order_selection_method,
      shape = order_selection_method
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_unified, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_unified, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes_unified, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    facet_grid(d_label ~ strength_label, labeller = label_parsed) +
    labs(title = title_use, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
}

combine_four_unified_rmse_ratio_models <- function(df,
                                                   file_name = NULL,
                                                   width = 16,
                                                   height = 12,
                                                   common_y = FALSE) {
  models <- c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
  
  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) %in% models)
  
  legend <- make_unified_method_legend()
  
  y_limits <- NULL
  
  if (common_y) {
    y_range <- range(c(df_use$RMSE_ratio, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    pad <- 0.06 * diff(y_range)
    
    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) {
      pad <- 0.05
    }
    
    y_limits <- range(c(y_range[1] - pad, y_range[2] + pad), na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  p1 <- plot_unified_balanced_one_model(df = df_use,
                                        model_show = "(1,0)",
                                        y_limits = y_limits)
  
  p2 <- plot_unified_balanced_one_model(df = df_use,
                                        model_show = "(0,1)",
                                        y_limits = y_limits)
  
  p3 <- plot_unified_balanced_one_model(df = df_use,
                                        model_show = "(2,0)",
                                        y_limits = y_limits)
  
  p4 <- plot_unified_balanced_one_model(df = df_use,
                                        model_show = "(1,1)",
                                        y_limits = y_limits)
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,
                                  p2,
                                  p3,
                                  p4,
                                  ncol = 2,
                                  align = "hv",
                                  axis = "tblr")
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "RMSE ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)",
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("Forecast horizon h",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.022,
                        size = shared_label_size)
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

### Plots for ECP


```{r}
benchmark_label <- "FARFIMA(1,1,0)"

method_cols_unified_ecp <- c(
  "FARFIMA(1,1,0)" = "#1B9E77",
  "Functional IC" = "#D95F02",
  "CV" = "#7570B3"
)

method_ltys_unified_ecp <- c(
  "FARFIMA(1,1,0)" = "solid",
  "Functional IC" = "solid",
  "CV" = "dashed"
)

method_shapes_unified_ecp <- c(
  "FARFIMA(1,1,0)" = 15,
  "Functional IC" = 16,
  "CV" = 17
)

prepare_unified_ecp_data <- function(df,
                                     alpha_show,
                                     T_show = 1000,
                                     window_show = "expanding") {
  
  df %>%
    filter(
      alpha == alpha_show,
      n == T_show,
      tolower(window_type) == tolower(window_show)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      forecast_method = case_when(
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("far", "far(1)", "benchmark") ~ benchmark_label,
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("farma") &
          order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("farma") &
          order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(forecast_method)) %>%
    group_by(
      n,
      d_true,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      alpha,
      h,
      forecast_method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      ECP = mean(ECP, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)",
          "(0,1)",
          "(2,0)",
          "(1,1)"
        )
      ),
      
      d_label = factor(
        paste0("d==", d_true),
        levels = paste0(
          "d==",
          sort(unique(d_true))
        )
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(
        paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi==",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      nu_label = factor(
        paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "nu==",
          sort(unique(ma_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      farma_label = factor(
        paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          ar_strength
        ),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      forecast_method = factor(
        forecast_method,
        levels = c(
          benchmark_label,
          "Functional IC",
          "CV"
        )
      )
    )
}

plot_unified_ecp_one_model <- function(df,
                                       model_show,
                                       title = NULL,
                                       alpha_show = 0.05,
                                       y_limits = c(0.85, 1.00)) {
  
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(
      as.character(model) == model_show
    )
  
  if (model_show == "(1,1)") {
    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      filter(
        abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10
      )
  }
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "No data found for model",
        model_show
      )
    )
  }
  
  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = ECP,
      group = forecast_method,
      colour = forecast_method,
      linetype = forecast_method,
      shape = forecast_method
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1 - alpha_show,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = plot_line_width
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = plot_point_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = method_cols_unified_ecp,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = method_ltys_unified_ecp,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = method_shapes_unified_ecp,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = sort(
        unique(df_sub$h)
      ),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0.02, 0.04)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = y_limits
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = plot_base_size
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = "black"
      ),
      
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = strip_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = axis_tick_width
      ),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(
        3,
        "pt"
      ),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(
        panel_spacing_size,
        "lines"
      ),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (model_show %in% c("(1,0)", "(2,0)")) {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ psi_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
    
  } else if (model_show == "(0,1)") {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ nu_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
    
  } else if (model_show == "(1,1)") {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ farma_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
  }
  
  g
}

      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

### Plots for Score ratio

```{r}
method_cols_score_ratio <- c(
  "Functional IC" = "#D95F02",
  "CV" = "#7570B3"
)

method_ltys_score_ratio <- c(
  "Functional IC" = "solid",
  "CV" = "dashed"
)

method_shapes_score_ratio <- c(
  "Functional IC" = 16,
  "CV" = 17
)

prepare_unified_score_ratio_data <- function(df,
                                             alpha_show,
                                             T_show = 1000,
                                             window_show = "expanding") {
  
  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(
      abs(alpha - alpha_show) < 1e-10,
      n == T_show,
      tolower(window_type) == tolower(window_show)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      forecast_method = case_when(
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("far", "far(1)", "benchmark") ~ "FARFIMA(1,1,0)",
        
        tolower(as.character(method)) == "farma" &
          order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        
        tolower(as.character(method)) == "farma" &
          order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(forecast_method)) %>%
    group_by(
      n,
      d_true,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      alpha,
      h,
      forecast_method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = forecast_method,
      values_from = Score
    )
  
  df_use %>%
    mutate(
      score_ratio_adaptive = `Functional IC` / `FARFIMA(1,1,0)`,
      score_ratio_cv = CV / `FARFIMA(1,1,0)`
    ) %>%
    select(
      n,
      d_true,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      alpha,
      h,
      score_ratio_adaptive,
      score_ratio_cv
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(
        score_ratio_adaptive,
        score_ratio_cv
      ),
      names_to = "order_selection_method",
      values_to = "score_ratio"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      order_selection_method = case_when(
        order_selection_method == "score_ratio_adaptive" ~ "Functional IC",
        order_selection_method == "score_ratio_cv" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ order_selection_method
      ),
      
      order_selection_method = factor(
        order_selection_method,
        levels = c(
          "Functional IC",
          "CV"
        )
      ),
      
      model = paste0(
        "(",
        p_true,
        ",",
        q_true,
        ")"
      ),
      
      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)",
          "(0,1)",
          "(2,0)",
          "(1,1)"
        )
      ),
      
      d_label = factor(
        paste0("d==", d_true),
        levels = paste0(
          "d==",
          sort(unique(d_true))
        )
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(
        paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi==",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      nu_label = factor(
        paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "nu==",
          sort(unique(ma_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      farma_label = factor(
        paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          ar_strength
        ),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      )
    )
}

make_score_ratio_legend <- function() {
  
  legend_df <- tibble(
    order_selection_method = factor(
      c(
        "Functional IC",
        "CV"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Functional IC",
        "CV"
      )
    ),
    x_start = c(3.5, 7.3),
    x_end = c(4.0, 7.8),
    x_text = c(4.3, 8.1),
    y = 1
  )
  
  ggplot(legend_df) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      label = "Order selection",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        colour = order_selection_method,
        linetype = order_selection_method
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = x_end,
        y = y,
        colour = order_selection_method,
        shape = order_selection_method
      ),
      size = legend_point_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        x = x_text,
        y = y,
        label = order_selection_method
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = method_cols_score_ratio
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = method_ltys_score_ratio
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = method_shapes_score_ratio
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, 11),
      ylim = c(0.85, 1.15),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    theme_void(
      base_size = plot_base_size
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
}

plot_unified_score_ratio_one_model <- function(df,
                                               model_show,
                                               title = NULL,
                                               y_limits = NULL) {
  
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(
      as.character(model) == model_show
    )
  
  if (model_show == "(1,1)") {
    
    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      filter(
        abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10
      )
  }
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "No data found for model",
        model_show
      )
    )
  }
  
  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = score_ratio,
      group = order_selection_method,
      colour = order_selection_method,
      linetype = order_selection_method,
      shape = order_selection_method
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = plot_line_width
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = plot_point_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = method_cols_score_ratio,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = method_ltys_score_ratio,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = method_shapes_score_ratio,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = sort(
        unique(df_sub$h)
      ),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0.02, 0.04)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = y_limits
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = plot_base_size
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = "black"
      ),
      
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = strip_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = axis_tick_width
      ),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(
        3,
        "pt"
      ),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(
        panel_spacing_size,
        "lines"
      ),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (model_show %in% c("(1,0)", "(2,0)")) {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ psi_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
    
  } else if (model_show == "(0,1)") {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ nu_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
    
  } else if (model_show == "(1,1)") {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ farma_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
  }
  
  g
}

combine_four_unified_score_ratio_models_shared_axes <- function(
    df,
    file_name = NULL,
    width = 16,
    height = 12,
    y_limits = NULL) {
  
  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    
    y_range <- range(
      c(
        df$score_ratio,
        1
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    pad <- 0.06 * diff(y_range)
    
    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) {
      pad <- 0.05
    }
    
    y_limits <- c(
      y_range[1] - pad,
      y_range[2] + pad
    )
  }
  
  legend <- make_score_ratio_legend()
  
  p1 <- plot_unified_score_ratio_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,0)",
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p2 <- plot_unified_score_ratio_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(0,1)",
    title = "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p3 <- plot_unified_score_ratio_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(2,0)",
    title = "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p4 <- plot_unified_score_ratio_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,1)",
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p1,
    p2,
    p3,
    p4,
    ncol = 2,
    align = "hv",
    axis = "tblr"
  )
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Interval score ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)",
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Forecast horizon h",
      x = 0.53,
      y = 0.022,
      size = shared_label_size
    )
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```
